data.titulo: Onthele 5—Tunde Poukonde Mombambilonia alo Pokupindulapo Ovimato vio Jelusalei
data.contenido:
Puetyi ova Isilayeli ankho vekahi koukonde Mombambilonia, vapita momahetaiko omanyingi, ekolelo liavo. Sadrake, na Mesake na Abedeneku, avayumbwa mofolono yatokota unene. Anthi, Huku evepolomo nomuenyo. Konyima, etyi Ombambilonia yateyuapo nova Medo Persia, Daniele ayumbwa meleva lio nonkhiyama. Mahi, Huku tupu emuamena, mokuaika omilungu viononkhiyama.

Okuhulako, Siru ohamba yo Persia, wayovola ova Isilayeli. Avakondoka motyilongo tyavo, konyima yomanima 70, tunde puetyi vatualwa oukonde Kombambilonia. Otyipuka tyotete valinga etyi vehika mo Jelusalei, okupindulapo ondyuo ya Yehova. Anthi, onondyale ambuya okutalameka ovilinga viavo. Moluotyo, ondyuo ya Huku yapwa vala, konyima yomanima 22 tunde puetyi vakondoka mo Jelusalei.

Komutue, matukelilongesa kombinga youngendi wa Esdra, wokukondoka ko Jelusalei opo akahiuise ondyuo ya Huku. Otyo tyapita konyima yomanima 45, tunde puetyi ondyuo ya Huku yapwa. Etyi papita omanima 13, tunde poungendi wa Esdra, Neemia eya okukuatesako ova Isilayeli okupindulapo ovimato vio Jelusalei. Onthele ya TANO ina ehipululo liomanima 152, alo pomuvo oo.

OVAKUENDYE ava vetatu uvehinangela? Enga, omapanga a Daniele, una waanyene ovikulia viohamba. Ova Mbambilonia ankho veveluka Sadrake, Mesake na Abedeneku. Mahi, pahe nkhele vetala tupu polutalatu apa. Omokonda yatyi, kavafendela otyilolo etyi, ngetyi vakuavo aveho vekahi nokulinga? Tutalei omokonda yatyi.

Ove uhinangela ovitumino vina Yehova ahonekele, vitiwa Ovitumino Ekwi? Otyitumino tyotete tyati: ‘Wahafende ono huku ononkhuavo. Una yokufenda vala ame.’ Ovakuendye ava, vekahi nokutavela otyitumino otyo, namphila katyapepukile okutyilinga.

Nambukondonosole ohamba yo Mombambilonia, ankho wakonga ovanthu ovanyingi vana vakolela, opo veye okufenda otyilolo etyi atungisa. Wapopila ovanthu aveho okuti: ‘Tyina mueiva ononkhuino, noharpa, novipuka ovikuavo viokuhika vikahi nokuhika, onue amuho nyongamenei pohi, iya amufende otyilolo etyi tyo olu. Una wahanyongamene, nokufenda otyilolo etyi, mayumbwa mofolono yatokota unene.’

Etyi Nambukondonosole etyiiva okuti Sadrake na Mesake na Abedeneku, kavafendele otyilolo, anumana unene. Atumu okuveeta ponthele yae. Eveavela vali omphitilo onkhuavo yokufenda otyilolo. Mahi, ovakuendye ovo, vayumba onthumbi mu Yehova. Avapopila Nambukondonosole okuti: ‘Huku yetu ou tukahi nokuumbila, upondola okutuyovola. Mahi, namphila ketuyovolele, onthue kamatufende otyilolo tyove tyo olu.’

Nambukondonosole okutyiiva otyo, anumana vali unene nkhele. Ankho pena ofolono imue ikahi popepi, atumu okuti: ‘Tokotesei ofolono oyo ovikando epanduvali, tyipona etyi itokautale.’ Aholovona pomafualali ae ovalume vapama unene, opo vakute Sadrake, na Mesake na Abedeneku, veveyumbe mofolono. Ofolono ankho yatokota unene. Iya ovalume ovo ankho vokuapama unene avankhi nomutemo wofolono. Mahi, oityi tyapita novakuendye vana vetatu, vayumbwa mokati kofolono?

Etyi ohamba atala mokati kofolono, akala nouoma omunene. Iya apulu okuti: ‘Katuayumbile mofolono ovanthu vetatu vakutwa?’

Ovaundapi vae avakumbulula okuti: ‘Enga, tuayumbamo.

Ohamba ati: Mahi, ame pahe ndyiete ovalume vekuana vekahi nokuendaenda. Kavakutilwe, tupu kavekahi nokupia. Omulume wakuana ulinga ngo huku.’ Iya ohamba afuene ponthele yombundi yofolono, aihana peulu okuti: ‘Sadrake! Mesake! Abedeneku! Vaumbili va Huku Omukulami, lupukeimo.’

Etyi valupukamo, aveho avamono okuti otupia katueveyokele. Okuhulako ohamba ati: ‘Huku ya Sadrake, na Mesake na Abedeneku, ankhimanekwe. Watuma oandyu yae opo iveyovole. Mokonda kavafendele o huku onkhuavo. Vafenda vala Huku yavo muene.’

Ongelaka oyo ongwa yokukolela mu Yehova, haiyoko tuesukisa okulandula?Êxodo 20:3; Daniel 3:1-30. Omapulo

OITYI tyikahi nokupita polutalatu apa? Ovanthu vekahi motyipito otyinene. Ohamba yo Mbambilonia ankho yakonga ovanthu ovanyingi vokuakolela. Ankho vekahi nokuundapesa onokopo mbo olu, nombo palata, no nombasiya mbapolelwe mondyuo ya Yehova ko Jelusalei. Mahi, liwa liwa, vamona okuoko kuomunthu kuhoneka motyimato. Ovanthu aveho avatili ouoma.

Ohamba, ankho o Belsazar omutekula wa Nambukondonosole. Atumu okuihana liwa ovanongo vae, ati: ‘Omunthu wetyivila okutanga onondaka ombu, no kumbuhangununa, mapewa ovipuka ovinyingi. Tupu makala omutumini watatu mouhamba.’ Anthi, nawike povanongo vae wetyivilile okutanga onondaka ombo mbahonekwa motyimato, ni okumbuhangununa.

Etyi me yohamba etyiiva, anyingila mondyuo ankho vekahi iya atolela ohamba okuti: ‘Wahatile ouoma. Mouhamba wove muna omulume umue, wii ono huku mbukola. Etyi ankho ho mbuale Nambukondonosole ohamba, wemulingile omutumini wovanongo vae aveho. Enyina liae o Daniele. Tuma vekemuihane, opo eye okukupopila oityi tyihangununa ovipuka evi aviho.

Daniele avemueta liwa liwa. Daniele waanya okupewa oviawa. Iya ahimbika okuhangununa omokonda yatyi Yehova apolele kouhamba he mbuale ya Belsazar, Nambukondonosole. Daniel ati: ‘Nambukondonosole ankho una omalityindailo unene. Moluotyo, Yehova emuhitisa.’

Daniele atolela Belsazar okuti: ‘Mahi, ove atyiho tyapita naho mbuale utyii. Nongotyo, ove nkhele walinga omalityindailo ngetyi Nambukondonosole alingile. Wapola onokopo mbatunda kondyuo ya Yehova, opo unuinemo. Ukahi nokunkhimaneka ono huku mbalingwa novimuti, nomamanya. Kukahi nokunkhimaneka Omutungi wetu Omunene. Otyo Huku atumina okuoko kuhoneke onondaka ombu. Daniele ati: ‘Onondaka ombu mbati: MENE, MENE, TEQUEL PARSIM.’

‘MENE, ihangununa okuti, Huku wavalula ononthiki mbouhamba wove, iya pahe mbapuako. TEQUEL, ihangununa okuti, Huku wekupaka kotyipesalo, atale okuti kukahi nawa. PARSIM, ihangununa okuti, ouhamba wove mewavela ova Medo nova Persia.’

Daniele ankho kenemane okupopia, omafualali o Medo no Persia, ahimbika okunyingila Mombambilonia. Epundaumbo avelitambula, Belsazar avemuipaa. Onondaka ombo mbahonekwa nokuoko, mbafuisuapo motyinthiki tyatyo otyo. Iya pahe, oityi matyipiti nova Isilayeli? Matuketyivasa komutue. Mahi nkhele, tutalei oityi tyapita na Daniele.Daniel 5:1-31. Omapulo

TALA! Daniele ngoti ukahi movitateka ovinene. Mahi, ononkhulika kambukahi nokumulinga omapita. Ove utyii omokonda yatyi? Olie wapaka Daniele mo nonkhiyama ombo ambuho? Tutalei.

Ohamba yo Mbambilonia ankho pahe o Dariu. Dariu ankho uhole unene Daniele. Mokonda Daniele ankho ondalawa, tupu omunongo. Dariu ankho waholovona Daniele opo akale onkhalamutue mouhamba wae. Moluotyo, ovalume ovakuavo mouhamba, avalingila Daniele onkhi.

Ovalume ovo vaya ku Dariu, avati: ‘Onthue tuatokola okuti ove Hamba, mohoneka otyitumino tyokuti mononthiki 30, nawike omunthu upondola okulikuambela ku huku omukuavo ine okomunthu. Ovanthu aveho vena okulikuambela vala kuove Hamba. Una wehetavela, una yokuyumbwa meleva lio nonkheyama.’ Dariu ankho ketyii omokonda yatyi ovalume ovo vahandela otyitumino otyo. Mahi, wasoka okuti olusoke olo lukahi nawa. Atumu okuhoneka otyitumino otyo. Iya pahe ankho katyipondola vali okupilululwa.

Etyi Daniele eiva otyitumino otyo, aende keumbo liae, ekelikuambela ngetyi ankho alingale. Ovalume ovo vonondingavivi, ankho vetyii okuti Daniele kamayekepo okulikuambela ku Yehova. Avahambukwa unene, mokonda ankho ehando liavo limoneka ngoti malifuisuapo.

Etyi Ohamba Dariu anoñgonoka omokonda yatyi ovalume ovo vahandela otyitumino otyo, anumana unene. Anthi, ankho kapondola vali okupilulula otyitumino otyo. Ngotyo, watuma okukayumba Daniele meleva lio nonkheyama. Mahi, wapopila Daniele okuti: ‘Ame ndyina ekevelelo liokuti Huku yove, ou ukahi nokuumbila, mekuyovola.’ Dariu kalele otyinthiki otyo, mokonda ankho wanumana unene. Etyi kuatya, akahatekela liwa keleva lio nonkheyama. Oyoo tala, polutalatu olu. Alaveleya, okuti: ‘Daniele, omuumbili wa Huku Yomuenyo! Okuti Huku yove ou uumbila, wekuyovola ko nonkhulika?’

Daniele akumbulula okuti: ‘Enga, Huku watuma oandyu yae, opo ipate omilungu vio nonkhulika. Moluotyo, kambandyipaele.’

Ohamba ahambukwa unene. Atumu okupola Daniele meleva. Konyima, atumu okuyumba meleva liononkhulika, ovalume vana ankho valingila onkhi Daniele. Etyi vayumbuamo kavehikiliale pohi ononkhulika ambuveyakula ambuveteyateya omankhipa no kulitunyaunina.

Okuhulako Ohamba Dariu ahonekela ovanthu aveho, mouhamba wae ati: ‘Ame ndyituma ovanthu aveho vakale nonthilo na Huku ya Daniele. Mokonda walinga omahuviso omanene. Wayovola Daniele ko nonkhulika.’Daniel 6:1-28. Omapulo

PAPITA omanima evali tunde etyi Ombambilonia yatambulwa nova Medo nova Persia. Pahe tala, oityi tyikahi nokupita apa? Ovaisilayeli vekahi nokutunda Mombambilonia. Oñgeni vetyivila okuyovoka? Olie weveyeka vaye?

Siru, ohamba yo Persia, oe wevetuma okuenda. Etyi nkhele Siru ehenetyitwe, Isaia omuuli wa Yehova, wahoneka kombinga ya Siru okuti: ‘Ove mokalinga etyi nahanda. Omapito maakala aikuka, opo unyingile mepundaumbo.’ Siru wakala onkhalamutue movilwa viokunyingila Mombambilonia. Omafualali oko Medo noko Persia anyingila mepundaumbo olio kounthiki. Vakuata pombundi, mokonda ankho omapito veevasa aikuka.

Tupu omuuli wa Yehova Isaia, wati Siru makatuma okukapindulapo o Jelusalei nondyuo ya Huku. Okuti Siru alingi umue tyili ngotyo? Enga. Siru watolela ova Isilayeli okuti: ‘Pahe, endei ko Jelusalei mukapindulepo ondyuo ya Yehova, Huku yenyi.’ Ovaisilayeli ava polutalatu olu, otyo mavakalinga.

Mahi, ova Isilayeli aveho ankho vokukahi mo Mbambilonia, kavetyivilile okukondoka ko Jelusalei. Mokonda oungendi oo ankho omunene unene. Ankho pena ono kilometu 800. Iya ovanthu vamue ankho vakulupa, ovakuavo vavela. Ngotyo, ankho kavetyili okulinga oungendi oo omunene. Tupu vamue kavetyivilile okuenda, mokonda yomahunga omakuavo vali. Mahi, Siru wapopila vana ankho vahapondola okuenda okuti: ‘Avelei ava mavaende o olu no palata noviawa ovikuavo, opo vakatunge o Jelusalei nondyuo ya Huku.’

Ngotyo, ova Isilayeli vana ankho vekahi mondyila yokuenda ko Jelusalei, vapewa ovipuka ovinyingi. Tupu, Siru wevekondolela ono kopo mbuna Nambukondonosole apolele mondyuo ya Yehova, puetyi ateyapo o Jelusalei. Moluotyo, ovanthu ankho vena ovipuka ovinyingi pala okutyinda.

Konyima yonohanyi ononkhuana mboungendi, ova Isilayeli vehika mo Jelusalei. Ankho papita omanima 70, tunde etyi epundaumbo liahanyaunuapo. Ankho otyilongo tyesalele tyihena omunthu nawike. Pahe ankho ova Isilayeli vakondoka motyilongo tyavo muene. Anthi, ankho vakevelela okupita movitateka vimue viatena, ngetyi matukelilongesa komutue.Isaías 44:28; 45:1-4; Esdras 1:1-11. Omapulo

OVANTHU 50.000, valinga oungendi omunene okutunda Kombambilonia okuenda ko Jelusalei. Mahi, etyi vehika, vavasa o Jelusalei ankho yahanyauka. Naumue vali omunthu ankho ukalamo. Ova Isilayeli ankho vena yokutunga vali ovipuka aviho.

Otyipuka vatetekela okulinga, okutunga o altar. O altar omphangu muna ankho valingila ovilikutila viovinyama pala Yehova. Monohanyi mbehehi, avahimbika okutunga ondyuo ya Huku. Anthi, onondyale ankho mbukala povilongo viopopepi, kavahandele ova Isilayeli vatunge ondyuo oyo. Moluotyo, vahimbika okuvehonga opo vakale nouoma, vayekepo okutunga. Okuhulako, onondyale ombo vaita kohamba omphe yo Persia, opo alinge otyitumino tyimue tyitalamesa ovilinga ovio viokutunga.

Papita omanima 17, tunde etyi ova Isilayeli ankho vantunda Kombambilonia. Yehova atumu ovauli vae Ageu na Zakaria, vapopile ovanthu opo vahimbike okutunga vali. Ovanthu vayumba onthumbi mekuateso lia Huku, avetavela kovauli. Avahimbika vali okutunga, namphila ankho otyitumino tyati kavapondola okutunga.

Moluotyo, omutumini umue wo Persia ankho utiwa o Tatenai, eya okupula ova Isilayeli omokonda yatyi ankho vatungila ondyuo ya Huku. Ovaisilayeli avemukumbulula okuti, etyi ankho tukahi Kombambilonia, Ohamba Siru wetupopilile okuti: ‘Endei ko Jelusalei mukatunge ondyuo ya Yehova, Huku yenyi.’

Pomuvo opo Siru ankho wankhiale. Tatenai atumu omukanda Kombambilonia, okupula inkha Siru tyili wevetumine okutunga. Ohamba omphe yo Persia aitumikisa omukanda wekumbululo. Apopi okuti otyili Siru otyo evetumine. Tupu ohamba ahoneka okuti: ‘Yekei ova Isilayeli vatunge ondyuo ya Huku yavo. Ame nkhele ndyimutuma muvekuateseko.’ Mokuenda kuomanina ekuana, ondyuo ya Huku aipu okutungwa. Iya ova Isilayeli avahambukwa unene.

Pahe ankho papita omanima 48. Ovanthu ankho vahepa. Moluotyo, epundaumbo no ondyuo ya Huku, ankho kaviehiwile. Esdra omu Isilayeli umue ankho wesala Kombambilonia, etyiivi okuti ondyuo ya Huku yesukisa okulingwa nawa. Ove utyii oityi alinga?

Esdra akapopia na Artaxerxe ohamba yo Persia. Iya ohamba oyo ongwa, aimupe ovipuka ovinyingi, opo atyindile ko Jelusalei. Esdra aiti ova Isilayeli vakuavo Mombambilonia vemukuateseko okutuala ovipuka ovio ko Jelusalei. Iya ovanthu 6.000 avetavela okuenda. Ankho vena opalata onyingi, no olu novipuka ovikuavo viakolela pala okutyinda.

Esdra ankho wasukalala, mokonda mondyila ankho muna ovalume onondingavivi. Ovalume ovo ankho vapondola okuvepola opalata no olu oyo vatyinda, aveveipaa. Moluotyo, Esdra waongiya ovanthu aveho, ngetyi weete polutalatu apa. Avelikuambela ku Yehova opo eveamene moungendi wavo wo kukondoka ko Jelusalei.

Yehova eveamena. Konyima yonohanyi ononkhuana mboungendi, vehika nawa mo Jelusalei. Otyo katyilekesa okuti Yehova ukwatesako vana vemuyumba onthumbi?Esdras okapitulu 2 alo 8. Omapulo

TUKONDOKEI nkhele ko-manima ana, puetyi ankho Esdra eheneende ko Jelusalei. Mordekai na Ester ankho ova Isilayeli vakolela unene mouhamba wo Persia. Ester ankho omukai wohamba, iya Mordekai ankho ulandula mohamba kokutumina. Tutalei oñgeni otyo tyaenda.

Ovo tate ya Ester ankho vankhia puetyi omututu, iya Mordekai emutekula. Asueru ohamba yo Persia ankho una ombala mepundaumbo lio Susã. Iya Mordekai ankho omuundapi wohamba. Onthiki imue Vasti omukai wohamba, ketavelele komulume wae. Moluotyo, ohamba aholovona omukai omukuavo, opo alinge omukai wae. Ove utyii olie omukai aholovona? O Ester, omuhikuena umue omuwa. Uluete omulume ou, ovanthu vekahi nokunyonga-​mena? Utiwa o Hamã. Hamã omulume umue ankho wakolela unene mo Persia. Hamã ankho uhanda Mordekai omulume ou weete waumphama polutalatu olu, nae anyongame. Mahi, Mordekai ankho kahande. Mokonda ankho utyii okuti katyaviukile okunyongamena omunthu wondingavivi. Otyo tyanumanesa unene Hamã.

Moluotyo, Hamã akapopila ohamba ounkhembi kombinga yova Isilayeli okuti: ‘Ovaisilayeli ovanthu vonondingavivi, kavetavela ovitumino viove. Vena yokuipawa.’ Asueru ankho ketyii okuti omukai wae Ester, omu Isilayeli. Ngotyo, watavela onondaka mba Hamã. Atumu okuhoneka otyitumino tyilekesa onthiki ova Isilayeli aveho vena yokuipawa.

Etyi Mordekai etyiiva, anumana unene. Atumu ondaka ku Ester, ati: ‘Una yokupopia nohamba, okumuita opo etuyovole. ‘Movitumino vio Persia ankho tyapenga unene okukapopia nohamba putyina wahaihanenue. Mahi, Ester aende okukapopia nohamba tyahaihanenwe. Ohamba ayulika Ester notyimuti tyae tyo olu, okulekesa okuti kamaipawa. Iya Ester akongo ohamba, na Hamã opo vakalie kondyuo yae. Puetyi ankho vekahi nokulia, ohamba apulu Ester oityi mahande okuita. Ester emukumbulula okuti, mandyikupopila vala inkha muya vali okulia muhuka.

Monthiki onkhuavo puetyi vekahi nokulia, Ester atolela ohamba okuti: ‘Elongo liange na ame matuipawa.’ Ohamba anumana unene, apulu okuti: ‘Olie wasoka okulinga otyipuka ngotyo?’

Ester ati: Ondyale yetu yetyihinda, omulume ou ondingavivi Hamã.’

Ohamba anumana vali unene. Atumu okuipaa Hamã. Konyima yotyo, ohamba apake Mordekai potyipundi tyavali koutumini. Iya Mordekai atumu okuhoneka otyitumino otyikuavo, okupopila ova Isilayeli opo veliamene putyina veya okuipawa. Mokonda ankho pahe Mordekai omulume wakolela, ovanthu ovanyingi vakuatesako ova Isilayeli. Iya ova Isilayeli avayovoka konondyale mbavo.Omukanda wa Ester. Omapulo

TALA ovilinga vikahi nokulingwa polutalatu apa. Ovaisilayeli vekahi movilinga ovinene viokutunga vali ovimato vio Jelusalei. Mokonda puetyi Ohamba Nambukondonosole ahanyaunapo o Jelusalei mo 152 yomanima konyima, ovimato wevitokesapo, iya omapito eepake otupia. Etyi ova Isilayeli vatunda Kombambilonia, kavetyivilile okupindulapo ovimato viepundaumbo.

Ovanthu ankho veliivite ñgeni, okukala mepundaumbo lihena ovimato? Ankho kavapamene. Mokonda onondyale mbavo ankho mbupondola okuveutukila. Mahi, pahe Neemia ukahi nokukuatesako ovanthu okutunga vali ovimato. Utyii olie Neemia?

Neemia ankho omu Isilayeli watunda kepundaumbo lio Susã. Kuna ankho kukala Mordekai na Ester. Neemia ankho uundapa mondyuo yohamba. Tyafuile ankho omapanga na Mordekai na Ester omukai wohamba. Mahi, Ombimbiliya kayapopile okuti Neemia ankho uundapela ohamba Asueru, omulume wa Ester. Neemia ankho uundapela ohamha onkhuavo yalandulako, itiwa o Artaxerxe.

Hinangela okuti Artaxerxe ohamba ina ongwa, yaavelele Esdra onombongo ononyingi, opo akatunge nawa ondyuo ya Yehova ko Jelusalei. Mahi, Esdra ketyivilile okupindulapo ovimato viepundaumbo. Pahe tutalei oñgeni Neemia alinga.

Papita omanima 13 tunde puetyi Artaxerxe aavela Esdra onombongo opo akaviukise ondyuo ya Huku. Neemia ankho utumina ovaundapi vokupaka okulia komesa Yohamba Artaxerxe. Tupu ankho oe wavela ohamba ovinyu. Nokutala nawa, opo vahapakeleko ohamba kokulia ine okokunwa. Ankho ovilinga ovio, viakolela unene.

Onthiki imue Hanani ondenge ya Neemia novalume ovakuavo, vatunda kotyilongo tyo Isilayeli aveya okutalelapo Neemia. Vapopila Neemia ononkhumbi ankho ova Isilayeli vekahi nokupita nambo. Novimato vio Jelusalei ankho nkhele vihenepinduluepo. Otyo atyinumanesa unene Neemia. Moluotyo, elikuambela ku Yehova.

Onthiki imue ohamba yamona okuti Neemia wanumana. Iya emupulu okuti: ‘Omokonda yatyi wanumanena?’ Neemia atolela ohamba okuti, nanumana mokonda o Jelusalei ikahi omapita. Ovimato nkhele kavi-nepinduluepo. Ohamba emupulu okuti: ‘Iya pahe ngotyo oityi uhanda?’

Neemia akumbulula okuti: ‘Mandyihande okuenda ko Jelusalei, opo ndyikapindulepo ovimato.’ Ohamba Artaxerxe ankho una eholelo unene. Apopila Neemia okuti upondola okuenda. Emukuatesako okulanda omavai pala okukaundapesa. Etyi Neemia ehika ko Jelusalei, watolela ovanthu otyilinga tyemueta. Ovanthu avahambukwa unene nolusoke olo, iya avati: ‘Tuhimbikei okutunga.’ Etyi onondyale mbova Isilayeli mbamona okuti ovimato vikahi nokuenda nopeulu, avati: ‘Tuendei tukeveipae, opo vayekepo okutunga.’ Mahi, etyi Neemia etyiiva waavela ovaundapi omitunga nomaonga, ati: ‘Muhatilei ouoma onondyale mbetu. Luilei ovakuatate venyi, novana venyi, novakai venyi, no nondyuo mbenyi.’

Ovanthu avalundu unene omutima. Avamaneka oviti viavo komutenya no kounthiki, otyo vatualako nokutunga. Mononthiki 52 vala, avamane okutunga ovimato viepundaumbo. Pahe ankho ovanthu vayovoka vekahi mokati kepundaumbo. Neemia na Esdra ankho valongesa ovanthu ovitumino via Huku. Iya ovanthu avakala nehambu enene.

Anthi, ovipuka ankho kavikahi ngetyi viali, puetyi ova Isilayeli nkhele veheneende oukonde ko Mbambilonia. Mokonda ovanthu ankho vatuminwa nohamba yo Persia. Ankho vena yokuundapela ohamba oyo. Mahi, Yehova walaa okuti matumikisa ohamba omphe. Ohamba oyo maikaeta ombembwa pala ovanthu aveho. Ohamba oyo olie? Oñgeni maikaeta ombembwa kombanda yoohi. Papita omanima 450, ankho nawike vali wii natyike kombinga yohamba oyo. Okuhulako, kuatyitwa olukembe lumue luakolela unene. Mahi, olio ehipululo ekuavo.Neemias okapitulu 1 alo 6. Omapulo
